headline: M K Proteins appoints Aritika Garg as independent director
hook: New board seat at M K Proteins
summary: M K Proteins Limited has announced the appointment of Ms Aritika Garg as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective August 22, 2026. Independent directors provide governance oversight and regulatory compliance on corporate boards. This is a routine corporate governance filing from a listed small-cap company. For Indian retail investors, board appointments of this scale have negligible direct impact on stock price or business operations.
why_it_matters: Routine governance update with no direct impact on your portfolio

headline: M K Proteins submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Routine procedural filing from M K Proteins
summary: M K Proteins Limited has submitted its annual general meeting scrutinizer report and voting results to the stock exchange for the meeting held on September 30, 2026. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing documenting shareholder approvals. Retail investors holding the stock can note the completion of the annual meeting formalities.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price
